about_the_game:
Reach Adventure 8: Makergod

Makergod plunges the Travellers into the savage heart of the Outrim Void, where the infamous Oghman raiders strike without mercy. These brutal clans have pillaged the same neighboring star systems for generations, reducing once-advanced worlds to pre-starflight ruin. But when the Travellers are swept up in an Oghman raid, they find themselves drawn to the raiders’ homeworld—a planet where advanced starship technology coexists with a society rooted in barbarism.

Oghma is a world of contradictions: laser rifles and ancient swords, patched-together starships and hand-cured armor, medieval apothecaries working beside airlocks. Beneath this fusion of the primitive and the high-tech lies a mystery stretching back over a thousand years—one that could reshape everything the Travellers thought they knew. Surviving Oghma is one thing; understanding it may be another entirely.

This adventure includes:

  • A brutal, immersive setting where starfaring raiders live like ancient warlords
  • Encounters that blend high technology and low-tech savagery in surprising ways
  • Opportunities for diplomacy, infiltration, and survival among a fiercely territorial people
  • An exploration of lost Sindalian legacy and the strange persistence of forgotten empires
  • A dark secret at the heart of Oghma—waiting to be uncovered by bold Travellers

Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: James Lillard

Requires: An active subscription or a one time purchase of a Fantasy Grounds license and the Traveller 2E (Mongoose) ruleset.

Screenshots may differ from what you see in-game based on the extension and ruleset you have loaded.
